# Book observer-repair source adoption

Delegated under KD-242. I read the complete current proposal, source contracts,
all sixteen planned controls and independent correction closure at book a61393d.
The retained proposal is in evidence/book-ownership-observer-proposal. Its four
current input hashes and six unchanged baseline hashes match the final review.
This is a recut after SITE03's observation failure, not actual verification.

Adopt the bounded proposal for implementation source only. Ordinary identity
queries may use at most two seconds, capped by original soft time remaining;
cleanup queries retain at most half a second. Each query runs once and every
failure still prevents acceptance. Independent signalling/hard stop, first-failure
precedence, observed identity history, serialized ACK and final decision, observer
quiescence and worker-visible stop checkpoints are explicit implementation work.
The visibility gap and incomplete historical-descendant coverage remain stated.

The old half-second ordinary query is an internal runner setting, not a registered
M3 acceptance figure. The whole 180 seconds, three-second cleanup reserve,
850 MB sampled limit, 450 MB heap, wait zero, two workers and no minification
remain unchanged. Complete checker/input/actual-exit/process closure is still
required. This adoption changes no measured gate reading and grants no automatic
retry or acceptance of unavailable observations. Two seconds is an unqualified
candidate setting, not measured sufficiency.

Development may implement the exact runner/worker seams and focused controls.
Controls must call the candidate routines and preserve their first-failure
identities; a duplicated state model is insufficient. The fourteen synthetic
state cases and two public fixture cases need exact separately reviewed command,
source/input binding and explicit bounded allocation before running. No collector,
VitePress build, real-output validator, browser, live probe or publication is
allocated here. Keep all reader/checker inputs and the already qualified 48
checker-control artifacts unchanged. Source and final packet review precede
any actual command. The deliverable remains complete 39-page verification.
